text: Arjun is severely allergic to peanuts.
Arjun has been vegetarian since 2019.
Arjun lives in Pune and works as a data analyst at a fintech startup.
Arjun broke up with his girlfriend Meera during their trip to Paris in May 2025.
Arjun's dog Biscuit, a beagle, passed away last month.
Arjun is training for the Pune half marathon in January.
Arjun's father had heart bypass surgery in August and is still recovering.
Arjun was laid off from his previous job in March 2025 and found it very hard.
Arjun is learning acoustic guitar and practises every evening.
Arjun prefers aisle seats on flights.
Arjun travels on a tight budget, usually under 40,000 rupees per trip.
Arjun's sister Kavya is getting married in Jaipur on 14 December.
Arjun is not a morning person and hates meetings before 10 am.
Arjun is lactose intolerant.
Arjun is saving up to buy a Royal Enfield motorcycle.
Arjun has been seeing a therapist for anxiety since the layoff.
Arjun's favourite cuisine is South Indian, especially dosa.
Arjun's best friend Rohan moved to Berlin this year.
Arjun is afraid of heights.
Arjun uses Python and SQL every day at work.
Arjun's mother is diabetic, so family meals are low in sugar.
Arjun is learning French on Duolingo, he started it for the Paris trip.
Arjun gets motion sickness on long winding bus rides.
Arjun's monthly rent is 22,000 rupees and he worries about money.
Arjun loves sci-fi novels, his favourite author is Ted Chiang.
Arjun is applying for a master's degree in data science in Germany.
Arjun's grandmother passed away in 2023; they were very close.
Arjun's laptop is a Windows machine with no GPU.
Arjun's birthday is 3 November.
Arjun used to walk Biscuit every morning at Pashan lake.
